ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across the visible ventral area with localized high-intensity (white) pixels limited to the peripheral edges and water spray interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray/black geometric region covering the majority of both lobes. Light-gray/white focal spots are visible along the far-right trailing edge and as highlight streaks on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 125 degrees, reaching a depth relative to the highest lobe peak of approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire upper trailing edge boundary, featuring multiple irregular peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-curving distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (darker than surrounding gray) located on the mid-section of the left lobe, indicating rake mark patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the distal tip of the right lobe, departing from the smooth curve seen on the left tip.
